edits.old: Then the scanner folder of "BR-0123" is read from the property set and no folder name is set in code
edits.new:
Then the scanner folder of "BR-0123" is read from the property set and no folder name is set in code

  Scenario: AC19 A partner subfolder code unknown or partner not ACTIVE is refused (exception X3, legacy RWB-E1-057 AC7)
    Given file "partner-0001.pdf" in the SFTP subfolder "LF-099" of the partner inbound folder
    When the intake job runs
    Then the system writes no document_intake row for "partner-0001.pdf"
    Then "partner-0001.pdf" is in the rejected folder
    Then the job record shows the file refused with MSG-P5-007

  Scenario: AC20 No new file on any channel logs a run with zero counts (exception X5)
    Given no new file is in any channel folder or mailbox
    When the intake job runs
    Then the job record shows the run with zero counts on every channel
    Then the system writes no document_intake row

  Scenario: AC21 An email with no usable attachment is archived without an intake row (exception X9)
    Given email "mail-0001" with no attachment and email "mail-0002" whose only attachment is an image of 6 KB, below INTAKE_MIN_IMAGE_KB
    When the intake job runs
    Then both emails are archived
    Then the system writes no document_intake row for either email

  Scenario: AC22 A user without Platform administration U cannot rerun the job (exception X12)
    Given RW-CASEOWN has no Platform administration U permission
    When RW-CASEOWN reruns JOB-12
    Then the system answers 403 with MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC23 Types, sizes and windows come from parameters, not code (BR8)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock returns the document-hub parameters INTAKE_ALLOWED_TYPES, INTAKE_MAX_FILE_MB, INTAKE_DUPLICATE_WINDOW_DAYS and INTAKE_MIN_IMAGE_KB
    When the intake job runs
    Then the allowed types, the size limit, the duplicate window and the minimum image size are read from those parameters
    Then no type list, size limit or window is set as a literal in code

  Scenario: AC24 The provided operations answer 401, 403 and 404 (section 12.1)
    Given a request to an operation of section 12.1 without a valid credential
    When the request is sent
    Then the system answers 401
    Then the system answers 403 to a user without the required right
    Then the system answers 404 for a run that does not exist

  Scenario: AC25 A retried or timed-out pickup activity does not take in a file twice (BR5, BR6)
    Given the pickup activity fails with a transient error on file "scan-0010.pdf" and is retried (retry count: Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P5-E1057-APP-AC23))
    When the retry runs
    Then "scan-0010.pdf" has one document_intake row
    Then a timed-out pickup activity leaves the file to be counted as a duplicate on the next run (timeout: Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P5-E1057-APP-AC23))
